principle.name: CLEAR THE BUTT BEFORE YOU LOAD THE TIP
principle.pocket_rule: WHEN REAR SHAFT VOLUME IS OCCLUDED, MOVE THE ROOT TO BUY CLEARANCE BEFORE THE COIL.
principle.fresh_interpretation: A long thrust under partial cover is a two-ended clearance problem. The strike begins with a lateral support/root acquisition that frees the butt end. Only then can the body coil, wedge, enter, contact, compress, disengage axially, and pay delayed butt-end recovery debt.
